items.prompt:
Thermal energy naturally moves from:
A) Cooler to warmer
B) Warmer to cooler
C) Nowhere
D) Only upward

steps: Heat flows from warmer objects to cooler ones.

items.prompt:
An insulator is a material that:
A) Speeds up heat transfer
B) Slows heat transfer
C) Creates heat
D) Destroys heat

steps: Insulators slow the transfer of heat.

items.prompt:
Which is a good insulator?
A) Metal
B) Foam
C) Copper
D) Aluminum

steps: Foam slows heat transfer, so it is an insulator.

items.prompt:
To keep a drink hot for a long time, a cup should be made of a good:
A) Conductor
B) Insulator
C) Magnet
D) Battery

steps: An insulator slows the heat leaving the drink.

items.prompt:
Which box keeps an ice cube frozen longer?
A) A metal box
B) A foam box
C) An open box
D) A copper box

steps: Foam insulates, slowing heat from entering.

items.prompt:
An engineer's cooler melts ice too fast. The best modification is to:
A) Remove insulation
B) Add more insulation
C) Use metal walls
D) Leave it open

steps: More insulation slows heat transfer into the cooler.

items.prompt:
A device is meant to transfer heat to food as fast as possible. It should be made of a:
A) Good insulator
B) Good conductor
C) Foam material
D) Air gap

Why does a thermos keep drinks hot?
A) It adds heat
B) It minimizes heat transfer with insulation and air gaps
C) It conducts heat away
D) It uses magnets
items.answer: B) It minimizes heat transfer with insulation and air gaps

steps: A thermos is designed to minimize heat transfer out of the drink.
